data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month as an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock8 and the low-outcome next stock16. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-run.
